questions.q: A professional who designs roads, bridges, and dams is known as a:
questions.explain: Civil Engineers differ from Architects; while Architects focus on the aesthetics and functional layout of buildings, Civil Engineers focus on the structural design and construction of infrastructure like roads, bridges, and dams.

questions.q: Who is responsible for drawing plans and specifications for machines and machine parts?
questions.explain: A Mechanical Draughtsman specializes in creating technical drawings and plans for machinery and mechanical devices.

questions.q: Which career involves working primarily with wood to build structures and furniture?
questions.explain: Carpentry is the skilled trade of cutting, shaping, and joining timber.
